rationale: Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund IV financed the 2021 hybrid investment and Stonepeak became the 100% common controller on February 6, 2024. Akumin's revenue and operations are principally outpatient imaging, oncology and outsourced hospital clinical services, rather than ownership of a qualifying infrastructure-asset platform. The company should therefore be retired from the PortCo census, while the corrected ownership history is preserved. A 2026 contemplated debt-to-preferred-equity exchange remains materially unresolved.
recommendedChanges: Retire and unpublish Akumin at company level from the direct infrastructure PortCo census.
Correct Stonepeak's vehicle to Stonepeak Magnet Holdings LP and its fund attribution to Stonepeak Infrastructure Fund IV LP.
Preserve Stonepeak's September 1, 2021 hybrid entry and February 6, 2024 transition to 100% common control.
Preserve Thaihot as a former shareholder through February 6, 2024 and retain legacy public-equity cancellation history.
Do not create separate PortCos for Alliance, operating centers, hospitals, physician groups or mobile units.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether the February 2026 exchange settled and which RCF lenders, if any, became preferred-equity holders.
The owned-versus-leased/managed/JV center mix is not publicly resolved.
blockingReason: Current preferred-equity ownership after the contemplated 2026 exchange remains unresolved and must be resolved or explicitly approved as an exception before application.
